_note: LinkedIn field limits. 'linkedin_help' entries were read on LinkedIn's own Help pages on 2026-10-15 (url and quote). 'reported' entries are the limits LinkedIn's profile editor enforces as widely reported; we could not find them stated on a LinkedIn Help page, so the live character counter in the editor is the authority.

skills.quote: You can add a maximum of 100 skills to your profile.

invitation_note.quote: Each message can be up to 200 characters.
invitation_note.free_quote: You can add a personalized message to up to three connection requests per month.

automation.rule: LinkedIn's User Agreement (section 8.2) prohibits bots and other unauthorized automated methods to access the Services, add or download contacts, or send or redirect messages, and software that scrapes profiles.
